name: qartez_map
description: Files ranked by PageRank with their exports and blast radius (by=symbols ranks symbols). Use first in an unfamiliar repo. With boost_files, or uncommitted changes, ranks by what those files reach. A known name: qartez_find; boost_terms ranks around words.

all_files.description: Rank every file, tests and files without symbols included (ignores top_n).

boost_files.description: Files you work on: what they reach ranks first. personalize=false: x10 boost instead.

boost_terms.description: Words; files whose path or symbol names contain one rank higher (x5).

format.description: concise: file rows only. detailed (default): plus up to 6 exported signatures per file.

personalize.description: Seed the rank from boost_files or changed files (default true). False: plain PageRank.

name: qartez_find
description: Definition of a symbol by exact name: file, line range, signature, exported or private, and an id (path:Type.name) other tools accept. Takes qualified names (Type.method, stem::fn). No exact match lists the closest by words. Part of a name: qartez_grep; its uses: qartez_refs.

format.description: concise: name and file. detailed (default): plus signature.

kind.description: Only this kind: function, method, struct, class, extension, …

name.description: Exact or qualified name, a regex with regex=true, or an id path:Type.name.

near.description: Files whose graph neighbours rank first. Default: changed and recently read files; [] = off.

history.description: Also list symbols whose commit messages match (BM25). Default: on for several words or no name hit.

regex.description: Treat name as an unanchored, case-insensitive regex.

detail.description: full: a block per match with its id. rows: one line each. Default: full up to 10 hits, rows past that.

name: qartez_grep
description: Symbols whose name starts with a prefix (case-insensitive): kind, file, lines, exported or private. Several words, or rank=true, rank by words (BM25). For a partial or unsure name; an exact name: qartez_find. search_bodies=true finds text in function bodies instead.

format.description: concise: names only. detailed (default): kind, file and lines.

kind.description: Only this kind: function, method, struct, …

limit.description: Max rows (default 50; 20 ranked), most important files first.

near.description: Files whose graph neighbours rank first. Default: changed and recently read files; [] = off.

query.description: Name prefix (Foo = Foo*); words to rank by (a space); regex with regex=true; body text with search_bodies=true.

history.description: Also list symbols whose commit messages match (BM25). Default: on for several words or no name hit.

rank.description: Rank by the query's words (BM25 over names, parents, paths), even one word. Several words are ranked anyway.

regex.description: Treat query as an unanchored, case-insensitive regex.

search_bodies.description: Search the text of function bodies, not names: rows are path:line in function: text.

detail.description: full: adds each signature under its row. rows: rows only. Default: full up to 5 hits, rows past that.

worktrees.description: With search_bodies: search many worktrees of this repo at once: `all` or a list of paths.

refresh.description: With worktrees: re-read each worktree's state from git, not the recorded one (~1.5 s for 85).

name: qartez_read
description: Source of one or more symbols (names or ids path:Type.name), or a file's line range, with line numbers. A long file alone gives its outline and first 100 lines. Use after qartez_find or qartez_grep, not whole files. A file's symbol list: qartez_outline.

file_path.description: Alone: the file (long source: outline + first 100 lines; more: start_line, limit, max_bytes). With a symbol: its file.

max_bytes.description: Output cap in bytes (default 25000); a cut says where to read on. Alone with file_path: reads the whole file.

symbol_name.description: One symbol to read: a name, or an id path:Type.name as find prints.

symbols.description: Several symbols (names or ids) to read in one call.

with.description: ["callers"] adds up to 5 callers with signature and call-site line, saving a calls + read round trip.

name: qartez_outline
description: Every symbol in one file, grouped by kind, with line ranges and signatures. To see a file's structure before reading it; a symbol's code: qartez_read.

format.description: concise: names and lines. detailed (default): plus signatures.

offset.description: Skip this many symbols (pages of 100; the output gives next_offset).

name: qartez_deps
description: A file's direct imports and direct importers. For everything a change could break (transitive, co-change): qartez_impact.

format.description: concise: paths. detailed (default): with specifiers. mermaid: a diagram, only if asked.

name: qartez_stats
description: Counts: files, LOC, symbols, edges by language, and the most imported files. With file_path: that file's LOC, symbols, imports, importers, PageRank.

name: qartez_impact
description: What a change to a file could break: importers and co-change partners ranked together (seeded from the worktree diff), linked tests, transitive dependents. Call before editing a widely imported file. pending=true: call sites the diff still owes an edit. One symbol's uses: qartez_refs; direct imports only: qartez_deps.

include_tests.description: Count tests in the ranked list and blast radius (default false); the Tests group lists linked tests anyway.

seed_diff.description: Also rank co-change partners of files the worktree changed, not just file_path (default true).

pending.description: Follow up the worktree diff: changed call shapes and call sites not yet edited. file_path optional; tests included.

near.description: Files whose graph neighbours rank first. Default: changed and recently read files; [] = off.

name: qartez_refs
description: Every reference to a symbol (calls, type uses, imports), grouped by file with line and enclosing function. Use before renaming or deleting. Calls only, or chains past one hop: qartez_calls. A whole file: qartez_impact.

format.description: concise: files only. detailed (default): each reference.

include_tests.description: Include references from test files (default true).

near.description: Files whose graph neighbours rank first. Default: changed and recently read files; [] = off.

symbol.description: Symbol name; Type.member narrows; or an id path:Type.name.

transitive.description: Also list the files that depend on the referencing files.

name: qartez_calls
description: Callers and callees of a function, up to 10 hops. For every kind of use (types, imports): qartez_refs. A name with several definitions needs file_path or kind.

depth.description: Hops to follow (default 1, max 10; 0 = target only). 2 or more returns a signature-only call tree.

file_path.description: File that defines the function, if the name is ambiguous.

format.description: concise: names. detailed (default): with paths and lines. mermaid: a diagram, only if asked.

include_tests.description: Include callers in test files (default false).

kind.description: Kind of the definition (function, method, …), if the name is ambiguous.

limit.description: Max rows per section (default 50), nearest first; a cut names how to narrow.

name.description: Function or method name, or an id path:Type.name.

near.description: Files whose graph neighbours rank first. Default: changed and recently read files; [] = off.

name: qartez_replace_symbol
description: Replace a symbol's whole definition, signature included, with new_code. To add code beside it: qartez_insert_before_symbol or qartez_insert_after_symbol. Preview unless apply=true.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Symbol kind, if the name is ambiguous.

new_code.description: The full new definition, starting with its signature.

name: qartez_insert_before_symbol
description: Insert new_code on the line above a symbol's definition. Preview unless apply=true.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Symbol kind, if the name is ambiguous.

new_code.description: Code to insert; a trailing newline is added if missing.

name: qartez_insert_after_symbol
description: Insert new_code on the line below a symbol's definition. Preview unless apply=true.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Symbol kind, if the name is ambiguous.

new_code.description: Code to insert; a trailing newline is added if missing.

name: qartez_rename
description: Rename a symbol everywhere: definition, resolved references, import and exposing lists; strings and comments are left alone. A file: qartez_rename_file. Preview unless apply=true.

allow_collision.description: Rename even if new_name is already defined in a file it rewrites.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Symbol kind, if the name is ambiguous.

name: qartez_move
description: Move a top-level symbol to another file, repointing importers (Elm, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust). Preview unless apply=true.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

kind.description: Symbol kind, if the name is ambiguous.

name: qartez_safe_delete
description: Delete a symbol, listing every reference that would break; refuses while any remain unless force=true. Preview by default.

file_path.description: File that defines the symbol, if the name is ambiguous.

force.description: Delete even with references left; you fix them.

kind.description: Symbol kind, if the name is ambiguous.

name: qartez_rename_file
description: Rename or move a file and rewrite the imports that name it (Elm, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust). Preview unless apply=true.

name: qartez_add_root
description: Start indexing a directory now so later queries need not wait. Optional: a path is indexed when first asked about.

name: qartez_workspace
description: As qartez_add_root: action=add starts indexing path now; action=remove does nothing.

name: qartez_analyze
description: Analyses by report: unused (exports nothing references), cochange (files changed with file_path/files), context (files related to files/terms), hierarchy (super/subtypes of symbol), diff_impact (what the uncommitted diff could break; tests), hotspots (churn x size). report=help: parameters.

report.description: The analysis; help documents each report's parameters.

file_path.description: Seed file (cochange); a file or directory to narrow to (unused, hotspots).
